program.name: Flow State
program.subject: Mobility & posture
program.blurb: Longer mobility flows, core circuits and light strength. Good between harder weeks.
program.about: Longer mobility flows, core circuits and light strength, for how you move more than how much you lift. The days cycle through hips and core, spine and shoulders, and a full flow. Level II slows the movements down and Level III adds reps. Good between harder programs or when you feel stiff.
